backend/main.mo: Main Motoko actor defining data types (Skill, JobRole, Resume, UserProfile), persistent state maps, default job role initialization, and mixins for authorization and blob storage.
backend/migration.mo: Migration module with a no-op run function that returns state unchanged.
feature_evidence.json: Feature evidence report documenting the loading state improvement for JobRoleSelector component to prevent premature error messages during initialization.
frontend-file-summaries.txt: Pre-generated summaries of all frontend TypeScript/React components, services, and hooks describing their functionality and responsibilities.
frontend/index.css: Tailwind CSS configuration with custom CSS variables for light and dark theme color schemes using oklch color space.
frontend/index.html: HTML entry point with root div and module script reference to main.tsx.
frontend/src/App.tsx: Root application component configuring TanStack Router with routes for home, analyze, dashboard, and admin pages, plus authentication state management and profile setup modal.
frontend/src/components/AccessDeniedScre: Access denied screen component displaying shield icon, error message, and return-to-home button for unauthorized users.
frontend/src/components/AdminGuard.tsx: Higher-order component that checks admin permissions via useIsCallerAdmin hook and conditionally renders children or AccessDeniedScreen.
frontend/src/components/DownloadReportBu: Button component that triggers PDF report generation via generateAnalysisReport service with loading state and toast notifications.
frontend/src/components/GapAnalysisResul: Component displaying matching and missing skills in two-column card layout, grouped by technical/soft skills categories with color-coded badges.
frontend/src/components/JobRoleForm.tsx: Form component for creating or updating job roles with title and required skills (name, level, category). Validates input, manages skill list state, and submits via mutation hooks.
Radio group component that fetches and displays available job roles as selectable cards, showing title, skill count, and skill badges. Handles loading, empty states, and selection callbacks.
frontend/src/components/Layout.tsx: Main layout wrapper with sticky header containing navigation (Analyze, Admin), authentication button, mobile menu, and footer. Conditionally renders admin link based on user role.
frontend/src/components/LoginButton.tsx: Authentication button component that handles Internet Identity login/logout, manages loading states, and clears query cache on logout.
frontend/src/components/ProficiencyGapCh: Bar chart component using Recharts to visualize skill distribution across proficiency levels (beginner, intermediate, advanced), comparing matching vs missing skills.
frontend/src/components/ProfileSetupModa: Modal dialog for first-time user profile creation, collecting name (required), email, education, and experience fields. Prevents closing until profile is saved.
frontend/src/components/RecommendationsD: Displays personalized learning recommendations for missing skills, including course links with providers and suggested project ideas. Shows success message when no gaps exist.
frontend/src/components/ResumeUpload.tsx: React component for uploading PDF resumes with drag-and-drop support, file validation (PDF only, 10MB max), progress tracking, and automatic skill extraction using NLP services.
frontend/src/components/SkillCategoryCha: Bar chart component that visualizes matching and missing skills grouped by category (technical vs. soft skills) using Recharts.
Pie chart component that displays the proportion of matching versus missing skills using Recharts.
frontend/src/hooks/useActor.ts: Custom hook that manages the backend actor instance with Internet Identity authentication, initializes access control with admin token, and invalidates dependent queries on actor changes.
frontend/src/hooks/useInternetIdentity.t: React context provider and hook for Internet Identity authentication, managing login/logout state, identity persistence, and AuthClient lifecycle with configurable options.
frontend/src/hooks/useQueries.ts: Collection of React Query hooks for user profiles, admin checks, job roles, and resume operations, all using the actor from useActor with proper cache invalidation.
frontend/src/index.css: Tailwind CSS configuration with custom CSS variables defining a warm, education-focused color palette in OKLCH format for both light and dark modes.
frontend/src/main.tsx: Application entry point that sets up React Query and Internet Identity providers, then renders the root App component.
frontend/src/pages/AdminPanel.tsx: Admin panel page for managing job roles with CRUD operations, displaying job roles in cards with required skills, and providing a form interface for adding/editing roles.
frontend/src/pages/AnalysisDashboard.tsx: Dashboard page that displays skill gap analysis results including match percentage, charts for skill matching/categories/proficiency gaps, missing skills, and personalized recommendations with download functionality.
frontend/src/pages/AnalysisFlow.tsx: Two-step analysis flow page where authenticated users upload their resume and select a target job role before proceeding to the analysis dashboard.
frontend/src/pages/HomePage.tsx: Landing page with hero section and features overview, explaining the skill gap analysis process and providing navigation to start analysis for authenticated users.
frontend/src/services/gapAnalysis.ts: Service that identifies missing skills by comparing normalized extracted resume skills against job role required skills using string matching logic.
frontend/src/services/nlpService.ts: Service for parsing PDF resumes to extract text, currently using simulated extraction but designed to integrate with external NLP APIs like Google Cloud Document AI or AWS Textract.
frontend/src/services/pdfGenerator.ts: Service that generates downloadable text-based skill gap analysis reports containing match percentage, matching/missing skills, and recommendations.
frontend/src/services/recommendationEngi: Generates personalized course and project recommendations for missing skills by matching skill names against hardcoded databases of courses (Udemy, Coursera, freeCodeCamp) and project ideas.
frontend/src/services/skillExtraction.ts: Extracts technical and soft skills from parsed resume text by matching against predefined lists of skills (JavaScript, Python, React, SQL, ML, communication, leadership, etc.) and normalizing the results.
frontend/src/services/skillMatching.ts: Calculates skill match percentage between extracted resume skills and job role requirements using exact and partial string matching, returning matching skills and a percentage score.
frontend/src/utils/urlParams.ts: Provides utility functions for extracting, storing, and managing URL parameters from both regular query strings and hash-based routing, with sessionStorage persistence support.
frontend/tailwind.config.js: Tailwind CSS configuration defining custom color scheme using OKLCH color space, typography, animations, container queries, and design tokens for the application's styling system.
project_state.json: Project metadata documenting the AI-Based Skill Gap Analyzer architecture, including React/TypeScript frontend, Motoko backend canisters, Internet Identity authentication, NLP integration, and implemented features for resume analysis and skill matching.
